verdict.rationale: Decagon's first-party docs describe AI-generated insights from customer conversation data inside the product. Ask AI answers open-ended questions such as "Why are customers requesting refunds?" over conversations. Watchtower flags interactions against natural-language criteria and surfaces what matters most. Suggestions detects knowledge gaps and drafts content, and Duet analyzes past interactions to generate AOPs and iterate on the agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these insight features work as claimed, and deeper documentation of how insight and suggestion quality is produced and validated.
